phrase.zh: 靠近太阳，冰尘便留下长尾。
phrase.en: Near the Sun, ice and dust draw a tail.

visual.zh: 彗核拖着明亮的弧形尾迹掠过太阳旁，强调升温与运动。画出的单一尾巴并不展示彗星可能同时具有的尘尾和离子尾。
visual.en: A comet sweeps past the Sun with a luminous arc, emphasizing warmth and motion. Its single drawn tail does not show the distinct dust and ion tails a comet can develop.

background.zh: 彗星由冰、尘埃和岩石组成。靠近太阳时，冰升华，释放气体和尘埃形成彗发；太阳光和太阳风可把这些物质推向背离太阳的方向，形成尾巴。
background.en: Comets contain ice, dust and rock. Near the Sun, ice turns to gas and releases dust to form a coma; sunlight and the solar wind can push material away from the Sun to make tails.
